rows.label: Sugar, Sugar
rows.description: original song written and composed by Jeff Barry and Andy Kim; performed by The Archies
rows.hook: was a bubblegum pop hit performed by a cartoon band from a Saturday-morning show

rows.label: 99 Luftballons
rows.hook: was a Cold War anti-war pop hit about toys floating into the sky, sung in its native tongue

rows.label: Gangnam Style
rows.hook: sparked a worldwide viral dance craze with a horse-riding move and a hugely watched video

rows.label: Take On Me
rows.description: song written and composed by Magne Furuholmen, Morten Harket and Pål Waaktaar, originally recorded by A-ha and released in 1984
rows.hook: came with a pencil-sketch animated music video where a woman is pulled into a comic book

rows.label: Macarena
rows.description: song written and composed by Rafael Ruiz Perdigones and Antonio Romero Monge, originally recorded by Los del Río and released in 1993
rows.hook: is a dance-craze hit with a choreographed routine that became a staple of parties and weddings

rows.label: Funkytown
rows.hook: is a disco-era dance track about heading to a town whose name is also the title

rows.label: Mmm Mmm Mmm Mmm
rows.hook: is a quirky hit with a deep-voiced singer, a hummed-style title and verses about odd childhood kids

rows.label: Come On Eileen
rows.hook: is a folky Celtic-flavoured chart-topper with a tempo change and a shouted plea to a girl

rows.label: Rapper's Delight
rows.hook: was among the first rap records to hit the mainstream, with a long party-rhyme opening

rows.label: What Is Love
rows.hook: is a Eurodance anthem whose chorus asks a question and adds a plea not to be hurt

rows.label: Tubthumping
rows.hook: is an anthem about getting knocked down and getting up again, chanted by pub crowds

rows.label: Spirit in the Sky
rows.description: original song written and composed by Norman Greenbaum
rows.hook: is a fuzzy-guitar gospel-rock classic about going to heaven when you die

rows.label: Barbie Girl
rows.description: song written and composed by Søren Rasted, Claus Norreen, René Dif and Lene Nystrøm; originally recorded by Aqua and released in 1997
rows.hook: is a novelty dance-pop hit about life in plastic that drew a legal fight from a toy company

rows.label: Ice Ice Baby
rows.description: 1990 song by Vanilla Ice and DJ Earthquake
rows.hook: is a rap hit built on a bassline borrowed from a Queen and David Bowie collaboration
